no_adcom_quote.quote: No advisory committee meeting was held, and no external consultations were obtained as there were no issues that needed input from external experts

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for the XENLETA (lefamulin) application (NDA 211672/211673). The FDA Multidisciplinary Review states plainly in Section 9 that no advisory committee meeting was held and no external consultations were obtained because there were no issues needing input from external experts. (The only committee mentioned, PeRC on 10 July 2019, is FDA's internal Pediatric Review Committee addressing the pediatric study deferral/waiver, not an advisory committee for the approval decision.)
